early-exit.timingScope: completed source excluded; GPU export, private Mach notice and consumer GPU draw separate; ACK includes independent all-pixel CPU oracle and declared pause

malformed-attach.timingScope: completed source excluded; GPU export, private Mach notice and consumer GPU draw separate; ACK includes independent all-pixel CPU oracle and declared pause

replay-ack.timingScope: completed source excluded; GPU export, private Mach notice and consumer GPU draw separate; ACK includes independent all-pixel CPU oracle and declared pause

single.synchronization: two independent command queues, sequential completion; two slots, one in flight; no IPC/failure-recovery claim
single.timingScope: GPU export draw then GPU consumer draw; each CPU submit-to-command-completion; generated source and all-pixel oracle excluded

stale-epoch.timingScope: completed source excluded; GPU export, private Mach notice and consumer GPU draw separate; ACK includes independent all-pixel CPU oracle and declared pause

stalled-consumer.timingScope: completed source excluded; GPU export, private Mach notice and consumer GPU draw separate; ACK includes independent all-pixel CPU oracle and declared pause

transport.timingScope: completed source excluded; GPU export, private Mach notice and consumer GPU draw separate; ACK includes independent all-pixel CPU oracle and declared pause

limitations: Generated quadrants only; no VM access, guest pixels, screen files or real display presentation.
Five sequential samples per format/geometry; no CI, FPS, gameplay or120Hz claim.
Cross-process GPU draw is not physical scanout; ACK includes CPU correctness checks and a declared pause.
Mach peer UID/owned-child identity and protocol faults are tested; production VM/session/authentication binding is not.
Shader-read usage is a role, not enforced read-only access to an IOSurface capability.
Local unsigned build provenance; no clean-machine release reproduction or distribution clearance.

method.backgroundWorkload: Interactive development host; other CPU/GPU work uncontrolled
method.outlierPolicy: retain all; two declared warmups per case
